# Overall Project Summary: Aug 6, 2026

Development on August 6 focused on stabilizing the core infrastructure, highlighted by the promotion of the `develop` branch to `main` and critical repairs to CI/CD fleet routing. The team also made significant strides in refining voice-interaction parity and onboarding flows, while addressing emerging challenges in container health and runtime compatibility.

## 🚨 Needs Attention 
- **[elizaos/eliza#13142](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13142), [#13158](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13158), [#13159](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13159), [#13208](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13208), [#13260](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13260), [#14749](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/14749)**: These issues are functionally complete but require human-verified evidence (e.g., live meeting capture, EER/FAR metrics, or adversarial testing) to move to a closed state.
- **[elizaos/eliza#13562](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13562)**: The nightly view-lifecycle soak test is failing, indicating potential memory growth or render-storms that require investigation.

## ✅ Completed Work

**CI/CD Pipeline & Fleet Stability**
*   Promoted `develop` to `main`, successfully deploying critical billing and onboarding fixes to production ([elizaos/eliza#17865](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17865)).
*   Resolved critical CI regressions in fleet routing and improved reliability by provisioning dedicated browser lanes ([elizaos/eliza#17814](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17814), [#17812](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17812), [#17854](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17854), [#17799](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17799)).

**Cloud Services & Onboarding**
*   Enhanced security and user experience by fixing SSO bridge atomicity and enabling onboarding for linked connector users without assigned agents ([elizaos/eliza#17788](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17788), [#17764](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17764)).
*   Fixed account-pool broker routing by correctly mounting them under `/api/internal` ([elizaos/eliza#17782](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17782)).

**Voice & UI Refinement**
*   Improved voice interaction quality by preventing filler speech during memory searches ([elizaos/eliza#17810](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17810)).
*   Polished branding and fixed desktop catalog inconsistencies to improve the user interface ([elizaos/eliza#17786](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17786), [#17864](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17864)).

## 🏗️ Work in Progress

**New Pull Requests**
*   [elizaos/eliza#17873](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17873): Fail-open Discord first contact and gateway egress retry.
*   [elizaos/eliza#17872](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17872): Release container placement held by legacy shared-tier rows.
*   [elizaos/eliza#17869](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17869): Integrate Cartesia realtime Talk in the chat overlay.
*   [elizaos/eliza#17867](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17867): Probe warm-pool entries to prevent node slot leakage.

## 🐞 Issue Triage

**New Issues**
*   **Cloud/Infra**: [elizaos/eliza#17840](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17840) (Docker build failures), [elizaos/eliza#17866](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17866) (Warm-pool health check issues), [elizaos/eliza#17823](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17823) (WhatsApp handshake failures).
*   **Voice/Runtime**: [elizaos/eliza#17842](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17842) (Mac ABI compatibility), [elizaos/eliza#17844](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17844) (Model-owned runtime semantics).

**Closed Issues**
*   **Benchmark Cleanup**: Closed 11 benchmark-related issues ([#13156](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13156), [#13161](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13161), [#13163](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13163), [#13170](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13170), [#13214](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13214), [#13296](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13296), [#13389](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13389), [#13392](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13392), [#13391](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13391), [#13479](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13479), [#16434](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16434)) following the removal of the `packages/benchmarks` workspace.
*   **CI/CD**: Resolved verification gates and workflow regressions ([elizaos/eliza#17813](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17813), [#17806](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17806)).
